lines.trans: Turn up the volume on the television, please.
Ivan and I both came from the people.
We both achieved a lot in life on our own.
Therefore I will support candidate Ivan Samsonov.
Thank you very much, Viktor Stepanovich!
I hope that we will work well together.
We will certainly live up to all people's expectations.
Now allow me to invite you to the bathhouse.
It is a genuine, good Russian bathhouse.
I heard that you are a big enthusiast.
Yes, I love a Russian bathhouse very much!
Great, then let us go right now!

examples.text: Теперь разрешите пригласить вас в баню.
examples.trans: Now allow me to invite you to the bathhouse.
It is a genuine, good Russian bathhouse.

examples.text: Да, русскую баню я очень люблю!
examples.trans: Yes, I love a Russian bathhouse very much!

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('big, large').

examples.text: Аракелян просит время. Сумма очень большая.
examples.trans: Arakelyan is asking for more time. The sum is very large.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

выйти.gloss: to go out, to get out

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to go out, to get out', paired with 'выходить'.

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks.

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.
Turn up the volume on the television, please.

examples.text: Давай повтори всё ещё разок громче!
examples.trans: Come on, repeat everything once more louder!

examples.text: А ты просто кричи на всех громче.
examples.trans: And you simply shout at everyone louder.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

meanings.en: to achieve, obtain; to win over

examples.text: Я всё равно вас добьюсь, Марина!
examples.trans: I will win you over anyway, Marina!

examples.text: Мы оба сами многого добились в жизни.
examples.trans: We both achieved a lot in life on our own.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'life' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Turn up the volume on the television, please.

examples.text: Не дышать, я хочу слышать каждый тихий звук.
examples.trans: Do not breathe, I want to hear every quiet sound.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, я уже знаю. Мне звонили из мэрии.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, I already know. The town hall called me.

meanings.note: in an election or for a job

examples.trans: He is a candidate for mayor.

examples.text: Я слышал, что вы большой любитель.
examples.trans: I heard that you are a big enthusiast.

examples.text: А теперь ничего не чувствуете! Значит, скоро влюбитесь.
examples.trans: And now you feel nothing! That means you will fall in love soon.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to love, to like', paired with 'полюбить'.

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: мы многое можем сделать = there is plenty we can do

examples.text: А мы многое что можем сделать.
examples.trans: Oh, there's plenty we can do.
Much has changed over this year.

examples.text: А мы многое что можем сделать. Вот, например, мальчик.
examples.trans: Oh, there's plenty we can do. Here, for example, is the boy.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'деяться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to hope, to rely on', paired with 'понадеяться'.

examples.trans: I hope so. Go on, act quickly!
There are a lot of people here.
The most important thing is the people.

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'стоящий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('real, genuine').

examples.text: Ваня, да пойми ты наконец! Это настоящий успех.
examples.trans: Vanya, understand at last! This is real success.

meanings.note: Core Russian num meaning 'both' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: You both leave here right now.
Get over here right now, quickly, both of you!

examples.text: Вы сейчас отсюда оба уходите. И больше сюда не возвращаетесь. Ясно?
examples.trans: You both leave here right now. And you never come back here again. Clear?
I'll definitely buy you a tank.

examples.text: Государство обязательно увидит и назначит операцию.
examples.trans: The state will surely see and will schedule the surgery.

examples.text: Мы обязательно оправдаем все ожидания людей.
examples.trans: We will certainly live up to all people's expectations.

examples.text: Вот это неожиданно! Ягодка вы моя!
examples.trans: Now that is unexpected! You little berry of mine!

meanings.note: of a court: меня оправдают = they'll acquit me
оправдать надежды = to live up to hopes

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда, меня оправдают. Аракелян заявление заберёт.
examples.trans: I'll get out of here, they'll acquit me. Arakelyan will withdraw his statement.

meanings.note: used as an exclamation of approval

examples.trans: I know this town really well!
I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'держать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to support, to back', paired with 'поддерживать'.

examples.trans: If you support me, we will break through.
The friends decided to support Samson.

examples.text: Короче, мужики! Если поддержите меня, мы прорвёмся.
examples.trans: In short, guys! If you support me, we will break through.

поехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to set off

meanings.en: to go, to set off (by car, bus, train)

examples.trans: All right, Arkashenka. We'll be off, it's time.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'этому').

examples.text: Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: That's why I'm running for a second term.
I'm tired, so I'm at home.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'гласить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to invite, to call in', paired with 'приглашать'.

meanings.en: to call in (a witness, a guest)

examples.text: В смысле, Виктор Степанович? Прямо так, да?
examples.trans: What do you mean, Viktor Stepanovich? Just like that?

meanings.note: polite formula, at a door or before asking something

examples.trans: May we come in? Good day, sir.

meanings.note: also a Russian man (as a noun)

examples.trans: Russian. Orthodox. Never been in prison.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

examples.text: Как странно, я ничего об этом не слышал.
examples.trans: How strange, I've heard nothing about it.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Я надеюсь, что мы успешно сработаемся.
examples.trans: I hope that we will work well together.

examples.text: Это слово «сработаться» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'to work well together' is often heard in conversation.

meanings.note: смотреть по телевизору = to watch on TV

examples.trans: I'll leave you this television set.
And the television, by the way, is ours!

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!
examples.trans: Now I'm the boss of our building site. You're fired!

examples.text: Я тебе тогда сказал: ты меня ещё поцелуешь.
examples.trans: I told you back then: you'll kiss me one day.

examples.text: Я надеюсь, что мы успешно сработаемся.
examples.trans: I hope that we will work well together.
We will surely successfully pass the inspection.
We successfully passed the difficult inspection.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('good, nice').

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

meanings.note: the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
